resources.string: Foreground-app detection and optional system-wide filtering

toadLIGHT uses this service for two things: detecting which app is in the foreground (package name only – never screen content) for per-app filter rules, and optionally drawing the warmth filter above everything, including the notification shade. No screen content is ever read, and nothing leaves the device.
Shows the current state of the warmth filter and its quick controls.
